integrity: The ordinary/J-complete-positivity intersection is proved from joint Choi positivity and involution support; the qubit disk is an explicit Kraus classification; the sharp Pauli metric has matching state-witness lower and channel-decomposition upper bounds. Numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional fixed self-adjoint involutions; qubit and sharp metric claims concern J_A=J_B=Z, Pauli-diagonal CPTP noise and the unhalved diamond norm. No universal approximation formula for other noise models or dimensions.
title: Ordinary/Krein channel compatibility and its exact Pauli-noise distance
